revisionDesc.change: Finalized - ready. APPCHANGE. note: in lin1 I cannot READ the abbr for καὶ; I could be better persuaded to Ἀπολλωνίου <καὶ> Πτολεμαίου.
Vote - AcceptText - Accept text. I agree with Josh's remarks and I don't see either (καὶ) in line 1. Paul's corrections should be marked as "=SoSOL P. Heilporn" and not "PN P. Heilporn".

Vote - AcceptText - Accept. Some very nice emendations here, with all of which except one (first καὶ in lin1) I agree. Passim: delete /*nothing*/ and just leave blank, display will read "Omitted." Passim corr-->reg. Lin1: I see καὶ very clearly after ὑιοῦ. But after Ἀπολλωνίου I see only a curving stroke slanting down and to the right, but not enough to make me think it the iota in καὶ; and I suggest that it looks no different from the upsilon in ἐμβαδοῦ πήχις (line3); so, I am inclined not to accept. Lin4,5: yes, I agree in both cases λ=30 is the more probable reading. Lin14a: accept line and line#; add space after vestig. Lin23: I see this clearly; accept. Lin24: I see β clearly (looks more or less identical to β below it); I *think* I can see faint traces of ι before it, but that might be an illusion of the digital image; I prefer to defer to Heilporn's reading of the original. Lin25: I think I might be inclined to dot the ι in ιβ, but again I am content to trust Heilporn's autopsy. Lin26: accept. Breaks at column tops: accept.
